categories.main_business_segments: Chino Corporation operates three main business segments: Measurement and Control Equipment (such as recorders and controllers), Instrumentation Systems (including performance evaluation and control systems), and Sensors (including temperature sensors and infrared thermography devices). The company also provides related services such as maintenance, calibration, and software development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies are centered on temperature measurement, control, and monitoring, leveraging proprietary sensor technologies (contact and non-contact), advanced control algorithms, and system integration capabilities. Manufacturing emphasizes precision assembly, calibration, and quality assurance, with ongoing investments in automation and concurrent engineering to optimize production flows.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chino primarily serves manufacturing industries such as semiconductors, electronic components, automotive, steel, and energy, as well as sectors like medical, pharmaceuticals, food management, and logistics. Its products are used in R&D, production equipment, quality control, and environmental monitoring applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a strong domestic presence in Japan and operates internationally through subsidiaries and affiliates in the United States, China, South Korea, India, and Thailand. Asia (especially China and Korea) and North America are key overseas markets, with sales also in Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chino operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing finished measurement/control devices, systems, and sensors directly to end-users and OEMs, as well as offering after-sales services and calibration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding into growth markets such as hydrogen energy, semiconductors, next-generation batteries, and decarbonization solutions. R&D focuses on advanced sensing (especially non-contact and high-value temperature sensors), IoT-enabled systems, calibration technologies, and cloud-based data services, with an emphasis on sustainability and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of products (measurement/control equipment, systems, sensors), system integration, and related services such as maintenance, calibration, and software. The company is also developing subscription-based cloud services for remote monitoring and data management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include companies like Azbil, Yokogawa Electric, Horiba, and other industrial measurement and control solution providers. Chino positions itself as a technology-driven specialist in temperature measurement and control, with a reputation for reliability and customization, but faces competition from larger diversified players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Chino reported consolidated net sales of 29.3 billion yen and net income attributable to parent shareholders of 1.99 billion yen, with approximately 1,100 employees. The company has demonstrated steady growth in sales and profits, achieving record highs in recent years, and targets further expansion to 30 billion yen in sales by 2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chino emphasizes its expertise in temperature measurement and control, offering highly reliable, precise, and customizable solutions tailored to customer needs. Its integrated 'loop solution' approach, combining proprietary sensors, control devices, and system integration, differentiates it in markets requiring high accuracy, compliance, and advanced data utilization.
